name: tesseract-prints
description: Tesseract Prints — confidential document printing and delivery. TypeScript monorepo: Fastify + MongoDB API, React web app, shared domain package.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n shared,api,web -c gray,magenta,blue "npm run dev -w @tesseract/shared" "npm run dev -w @tesseract/api" "npm run dev -w @tesseract/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @tesseract/shared && npm run build -w @tesseract/api && npm run build -w @tesseract/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @tesseract/shared && npm run typecheck -w @tesseract/api && npm run typecheck -w @tesseract/web
